title: Beyond Correctness: Evaluating Subjective Writing Preferences Across Cultures

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the accuracy of reward models and LLM judges on a bilingual dataset (English and Chinese) of subjective writing preference pairs to measure cross-lingual performance disparities and language-specific biases stemming from training data imbalances.

Testing models on a cross-cultural writing benchmark containing diverse genres adapted to both English and Mandarin rhetorical traditions to assess whether models learn universal aesthetic quality or rely on culturally specific heuristics.
